title: Cranial modification told to have been ordered by the gods

tellings.quote: one group uh a paper by gson and gson from 1995 where they interviewed them and said why why do you do this and they said because our ancestors were instructed by the gods to do this

plain: Mike Masters, a researcher who studies human origins, talks on Jesse Michels's podcast about cranial modification, the old practice of binding babies' heads so the skull grows long, found in many cultures including the Maya. He cites a 1995 paper by two authors named Gerszten, who he says asked one group why they did it, and were told their ancestors had been instructed to do so by the gods. Masters tells it because it could hint that the "gods" were real visitors whose heads looked different.
